latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — end-to-end equity compensation negotiation coach.

- Guides employees and candidates through evaluating, negotiating, and strategizing around equity compensation (RSUs, ISOs, NSOs, PIUs, and more).
- Covers multi-offer comparisons, negotiation tactics, tax-aware decision-making (ISO AMT, 83(b), QSBS), and timing of exits.
- Includes a diagnostic sweep of key questions to tailor advice per user scenario.
- Provides deep context on offer structures, vesting, refresh grants, and private/public company equity.
- Triggers on common compensation negotiation phrases and scenarios.
